name: Hex Party
source:
[b]"Wait, I need a 'true love's kiss' to break this curse?!"[/b]

One day, a mysterious mark appears on you.
Worse, touching a man with this mark triggers a curse of forced intimacy!

By day, you are a capable CEO growing your own company.
But on weekends, it's time to get up close and personal with these men to figure out how to break the curse.
Juggling business and romance is never easy.
In this thrilling, unpredictable daily life, what kind of ending awaits you?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/5354650/Hex_Party/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
[b]“等等，要解开这个诅咒居然需要‘真爱之吻’？！”[/b]

某一天，你的身上突然浮现出一道神秘印记。
更糟的是，只要带着这道印记触碰男性，就会触发强制亲密接触的诅咒！

白天的你，是经营壮大自家公司的干练CEO；
可一到周末，你就得与这些男人们近距离深入接触，设法找出解开诅咒的方法。
兼顾事业与恋爱从来都不是件容易的事。
在这段惊险刺激、变幻莫测的日常生活里，究竟会有怎样的结局等待着你？

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/5354650/Hex_Party/]Steam[/url]]
